name: Classic Floor Lamp
desc: A traditional decorative floor lamp featuring an ornate dark metal body, a warm fabric bell-shaped shade, and hanging crystal-style accents. The tall slender form and vintage detailing make it suitable as an ambient accent light for classic and transitional interiors.

specifications.Body: Tall slender metal stem with ornate scrollwork
specifications.Decorative Accents: Hanging crystal-style drops around the shade
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 1650 mm overall height x 420 mm shade diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Bedroom / Reading corner / Lounge / Classic interiors
